ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the Arabic word عَصِيرٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. taʿaam
   B. ʿasiir
   C. shamʿa
   D. ʿiid miilaad

2. How is the Arabic word حَلِيبٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. bataatis
   B. haliib
   C. faakiha
   D. bayd

3. How is the Arabic word شَمْعَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dawrii
   B. hadiyya
   C. shamʿa
   D. sharaab

4. What is the special sign hamza (ء)? (1 mark)
   A. A dot below
   B. A long vowel
   C. A kind of number
   D. A short stop in the throat

5. Which sentence means 'The window is clean'? (1 mark)
   A. al-baabu kabiir
   B. al-kursiyyu jadiid
   C. an-naafidhatu nadhiifa
   D. at-taawilatu Sagiira

6. What is the name of the Arabic letter ذ? (1 mark)
   A. dhaal
   B. laam
   C. daal
   D. thaa

7. What does the Arabic sentence أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Thursday.
   B. There are seven days in a week.
   C. I go to school on Monday.
   D. I play on Saturday.

8. Which Arabic sentence means "I have a brother and a sister." (1 mark)
   A. أَبِي يَعْمَلُ
   B. هَذِهِ أُمِّي
   C. هَذَا أَبِي
   D. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ

9. How do you say 'on Monday'? (1 mark)
   A. yawma l-ithnayn
   B. usbuuʿ l-ithnayn
   C. al-yawm ithnayn
   D. ghadan l-ithnayn

10. Which Arabic sentence means "I have a gift." (1 mark)
   A. نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ
   B. عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   C. أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ
   D. أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ

11. What does the Arabic sentence الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The pen is in the bag.
   B. The book is on the table.
   C. The lamp is above the table.
   D. The cat is under the bed.

12. What does the Arabic sentence عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. May you be well every year.
   B. Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   C. Happy birthday.
   D. Do you have a party? (to a boy)

13. What does the Arabic sentence أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I speak with my mouth.
   B. I see with my eye.
   C. I smell with my nose.
   D. I hear with my ear.

14. What does the Arabic word أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (ahlan wa sahlan) mean? (1 mark)
   A. good morning (the reply)
   B. I am well
   C. I
   D. welcome

15. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is cold.
   B. The weather is hot.
   C. The weather is cloudy.
   D. The weather is rainy.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: maa ismuki? (2 marks)

17. Name four key words about the home in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

18. Translate into English: lii yadaani (2 marks)

19. Say where the pen is if it is in the bag. Write the sentence in English letters and translate it. (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into English: ummii tatbukhu (2 marks)

21. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u ya'kuluuna l-kaʿka (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — ʿasiir
   عَصِيرٌ is read ʿasiir and means juice.

2. B — haliib
   حَلِيبٌ is read haliib and means milk.

3. C — shamʿa
   شَمْعَةٌ is read shamʿa and means candle.

4. D — A short stop in the throat
   The hamza is a short pause made in the throat, like the stop in 'uh-oh'.

5. C — an-naafidhatu nadhiifa
   naafidha is window and nadhiifa is the feminine form of clean.

6. A — dhaal
   The letter ذ is called dhaal.

7. D — I play on Saturday.
   أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ (alʿabu yawma s-sabt) means: I play on Saturday.

8. D — عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ
   عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ (ʿindii akh wa ukht) means: I have a brother and a sister.

9. A — yawma l-ithnayn
   yawma l-ithnayn means 'on the day of Monday'.

10. B — عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

11. A — The pen is in the bag.
   الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

12. B — Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ (ʿiid mubaarak) means: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).

13. D — I hear with my ear.
   أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي (asmaʿu bi-udhunii) means: I hear with my ear.

14. D — welcome
   أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (ahlan wa sahlan) means welcome.

15. D — The weather is rainy.
   الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ (al-jawwu mumtir) means: The weather is rainy.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: What is your name? (to a girl)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba. The pen is in the bag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the item, 1 mark for the position word fii, 1 mark for the translation.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: My mother cooks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends eat the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
